rationalization.consequence: A filter needs washing but the shared supply cannot serve it
rationalization.required_action: Clear the washwater or waste capacity restriction and inspect the online-flow disturbance

rationalization.consequence: Backwashing disturbs the online flow past the declared bound
rationalization.required_action: Suspend the wash or restore the treated flow the disturbance comes from

rationalization.consequence: The filter passes solids; the bed is letting them through
rationalization.required_action: Inspect the bed and schedule a backwash

rationalization.consequence: The filter effluent is above the declared shutdown tier
rationalization.required_action: Take the filter out of service and backwash it

rationalization.consequence: The bed is fouling; the filter approaches its terminal headloss
rationalization.required_action: Backwash before the run reaches its terminal loss

rationalization.consequence: The backwash stopped before its table completed
rationalization.required_action: Find the abort or fault that ended the wash and restart it

rationalization.consequence: The filter's equipment faulted mid-wash; the sequence runs its declared fault step
rationalization.required_action: Repair the failed actuator and restart or abort the wash

rationalization.consequence: The washed bed did not return to its clean-bed headloss
rationalization.required_action: Investigate short-circuiting, blinding, or a damaged underdrain

rationalization.consequence: The washed bed is not ripening to its declared effluent turbidity
rationalization.required_action: Re-inspect the bed, the wash rate, and the filter-to-waste step
